annotations.title: Remove an integration from a chatbot

description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Remove an integration from a chatbot

Unassigns an integration from a chatbot, so the chatbot can no longer call any of its tools. The integration itself is untouched and stays available to assign elsewhere. The reduced tool set is pushed to the voice engine after the row is removed; if that push fails the request returns 502 and the integration is already unassigned locally but may still be callable until a later change syncs. This endpoint takes no request body.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

integrationId.description: Numeric identifier of the integration whose assignment is being changed. This is the integration id, not the assignment id.

name: remove_chatbot_integration
